_comment: Temporal-detection regression ground truth. All scenarios are scripted synthetic observations (+ optional synthetic ffmpeg fixtures). MUST NOT be presented as real-world incident performance.

footage_provenance.real_footage_note: No labeled incident footage exists in the workspace (backend/data/videos/* are unlabeled; eval/clips/* are color blocks). All temporal metrics measure scripted-input behavior only.

match_rules.note: A prediction matches when its category equals the GT event_type and |pred_midpoint - gt_midpoint| <= gt_half_window + tolerance.

events.description: Multi-stage incident-like sequence: approach, contact, removal, departure chaining into one event.
Brief single-frame contact; must be kept, flagged single_frame_candidate, confidence < 0.6.
Event at the recording start boundary (t=0.2-0.6).
Event ending at the recording duration boundary (t=29.2-29.6 of 30s).
Contact on a 160x120 synthetic fixture video; detection must survive downscaling.
Approach-departure on a darkened synthetic fixture video.

negative_scenarios.description: Ordinary passing / talking / sitting; must produce zero events.
Handshake greeting and waving; must produce zero events.
Empty scene (+ static synthetic video when ffmpeg exists); must produce zero events.
